speaker: Dale G. Renlund
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: “How Long Will It Be Ere They Believe Me?”
summary: Elder Renlund teaches that we can trust God and His promises, because our hope rests on Christ's faithfulness and not our own. He tells of a heart-transplant patient who survived against the odds and then complained that his oatmeal was cold, and of the children of Israel who kept doubting despite God's miracles. He asks us to remember what the Lord has done, erase any imagined asterisk that excludes us from His blessings, and rely on His promises.

Recording our own experiences is helpful. President Henry B. Eyring suggested that each day we should ask ourselves, “Have I seen the hand of God reaching out to touch us or our children or our family today?” He promised that as we did so, we would see evidence of what God had done. That will cause gratitude to grow in our hearts and testimonies will grow (“O Remember, Remember,” Liahona, Nov. 2007, 67).
